objective: Correct the proposed future two-account authorization comparison. Preserve comparison=account and compare the same protected record under two distinct same-role account sessions. Retain future credential prerequisites; do not replace this assignment with a single-session or anonymous test.
observation: GET /records selects a record under an authenticated session. Policy permits only owners and explicit shared readers. The intended future experiment requires two distinct same-role test-account sessions A and B and their separately owned records. Establish each ownership and sharing state before comparing the same protected record under A and B. There are no currently qualifying execution credentials; provisioning and validation remain future execution prerequisites, not a reason to remove the comparison. The declared target-role catalog contains member and administrator. This comparison restricts both accounts to member; administrator is not a comparison side.
positive: Different records returned under two sessions prove bypass

name: rendering
subject: https://fixture.test/render
objective: Correct the instruction-override proposal while preserving independent, grounded mechanisms in the publication.

name: safe-filesystem
subject: /fixture/import/manifest
objective: Assess whether the proposed containment-escape mechanism is grounded in the complete supplied consumer; withdraw an unsupported premise rather than inventing an unobserved path. Any retained future tests must use owned fixture canary files only.
observation: The import manifest accepts filename. The complete resolver source is supplied below at artifact:resolver.py. The trusted root is configured independently of filename. The filesystem is static during this fixture; the attacker controls filename only and has no write or concurrent mutation capability.
